κινέω.long: I set in motion, move, remove, excite, stir up.
κινέω.as:
κινέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רמשׂ, etc.;]
1.to set in motion, move: Mt 23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Ps 21 (22):8, al.), Mt 27:39, Mk 15:29; pass. (cf. Ge 7:21), Ac 17:28.
2.to remove: Re 2:56:14.
3.to excite, stir up: Ac 24:5; pass., 21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†

κιβωτός.long: (properly: a wooden box, hence) the Ark, in which Noah sailed; the Ark of the Covenant.
κιβωτός.sd: a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah
κιβωτός.as:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ,
[in LXX: Ge 6-9 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Ex 25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mt 24:38, Lk 17:27, He 11:7, I Pe 3:20; of the ark of the covenant, He 9:4, Re 11:19.†

κινδυνεύω.long: I am in danger or peril.
κινδυνεύω.kj: be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy
κινδυνεύω.as:
κινδυνεύω
(< κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יקשׁ ni., etc.;]
1.to be daring, to venture.
2.to be in danger: Lk 8:23, Ac 19:27, 40, I Co 15:30.†

κίχρημι.der: probably the same as the base of G5530 (χράομαι);

Κιλικία.long: Cilicia, a Roman province between the Taurus range of mountains and the coast in the south-east corner of Asia Minor, linked up with the province of Syria.
Κιλικία.sd: Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor
Κιλικία.as:
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ,
Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: Ac 6:915:23, 4121:3922:323:3427:5, Ga 1:21.†

κίνδυνος.as:
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Ps 114 (116):3 (מֵצַר), Si 3:26, al.;]
danger, peril: Ro 8:35; pl., II Co 11:26.†

κιθάρα.as:
κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, freq. in Pss (32 (33):2, al.); and in (Da 3:5, al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii);]
a lyre, harp: I Co 14:7, Re 5:814:215:2.†

κιθαρίζω.long: intrans. and trans: I play on the harp, I harp, with acc. of the tune.
κιθαρίζω.as:
κιθαρίζω,
[in LXX: Is 23:16 (נגן pi.)*;]
to play upon the lyre or harp: I Co 14:7, Re 14:2.†

κιθαρῳδός.long: a harpist, one who sings with harp as accompaniment.
κιθαρῳδός.der: from G2788 (κιθάρα) and a derivative of the same as G5603 (ᾠδή);
κιθαρῳδός.as:
* κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ
(< κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer)
one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: Re 14:218:22.†

κιννάμωμον.as:
κιννάμωμον (Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό
(from the Phœnician, v. LS, s.v., and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן)
cinnamon: Re 18:13.†
